== Title ==
<span lang="ja">オルデラン</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-121o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">相手がここで戦闘運命数を求めるたびに、相手の戦闘運命数を－１できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配していれば、フォース消耗が＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Light Side:''' Each time the opponent draws battle destiny here, you may subtract 1 from their battle destiny.

'''Dark Side:''' If you control here, Force drain is increased by 1 here.

The Japanese Light Side text uses <span lang="ja">できる</span> (may), while the original English card says to subtract 1.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-alderaan.gif|Original English printed face]].</ref>
